items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He got that job. That was his gig. So he got the best two players in town, which was Errol Grandy on piano and Wes on guitar.

ctx.x: I had taken Wes to the rehearsal, and it was with a trio. The guy that was the leader of the trio was a bass player by the name of...I can't think of his name, because everybody called him Stuff. And that was picked up because he calls everybody Stuff. So people just called him Stuff. That was just his name, because everybody was 'Stuff' to Stuff.

And the piano player was a gentleman by the name of Errol Grandy. And Errol Grandy was the, I guess he was the idol of everybody, all musicians in town. Errol Grandy was, like, the daddy of the musicians in town. And he was about 90 % blind. And such a talent. Everybody came to Errol, to get things straightened out, and he was always open to help, teach, do, or whatever.
What kind of music did they play?
